spine: Inspect one documented over-unification; separate appealing bridges from warranted relations, then test whether coherence pressure earns a distinct explanatory role.
art: A split editorial stage: cobalt and rust; incompatible fragments, provisional bridging ribbons, matrices and annotation marks whose links appear only with explicit status.
lines: Coherence Pressure investigates how an elegant explanation can connect observations more strongly than evidence permits.
It begins with a documented conversation where two childhood behaviors became one premature theory.
The book examines the steps that made this unification sound intellectually satisfying.
Its central distinction is between a coherent representation and a demonstrated common mechanism.
This proposed explanation remains a hypothesis that existing concepts might already explain.
Readers learn to inspect explanatory bridges while preserving the value of genuine synthesis.
